title: Runtime Errors and Exceptions
learning_outcomes: Describe the purpose and main behavior of runtime errors and exceptions.
Apply runtime errors and exceptions in a small Python example or interpret a representative result.
Identify one limitation, edge case, compatibility concern, or failure mode relevant to the topic.

content.intro: This lesson introduces runtime errors and exceptions as part of python exceptions, errors, and debugging. It turns the curriculum heading into a short, practical concept guide with a visual, example, and checks to try locally.
content.why_it_matters: Reliable software expects mistakes and failures. Reproduce the smallest failing case, assert the intended behavior, and fix the cause rather than hiding the symptom.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: An exception represents an error or other exceptional event that can be handled by matching handlers.
